task.text: Write a detailed Systematic Literature Review outline for the title "The impact of big data analytics on the education quality delivery: A systematic Literature Review". Use PRISMA guideline.

attempts.high: I'm putting together a systematic literature review and the working title is "The impact of big data analytics on education quality delivery." I want you to design the full outline yourself, following PRISMA. The structure, the way you frame the research questions, what review angle to take, how to organize the synthesis sections — all your call. Surprise me with how you'd shape it. Keep it detailed.
attempts.low: Write a Systematic Literature Review outline for the title "The impact of big data analytics on education quality delivery: A Systematic Literature Review" using the standard PRISMA structure. Use exactly these top-level sections in this order: 1. Introduction, 2. Research Questions, 3. Search Strategy (databases + search string), 4. Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria, 5. PRISMA Flow (Identification, Screening, Eligibility, Included), 6. Data Extraction, 7. Quality Assessment, 8. Synthesis of Findings, 9. Discussion, 10. Conclusion. Just fill in standard subpoints under each heading — no added sections, no reordering.
